# Descriptions
@@ 1
Causes the target’s appearance to be adversely affected. All rolls dealing
with communicating and interacting with other beings suffer a special penalty
of 10.
@@ 2
This spell influences the target’s decision about who to attack. If the target
of this spell is (or will be within 2 rounds} choosing his melee opponent,
this spell will influence that decision 20% away from the caster, Other
opponents must be available for this spell to work.
@@ 3
The caster causes the target to believe that he is being watched all the time
and puts him at -10% to activity.
@@ 4
As Look ofDisfigure I, except the penalty is -25.
@@ 5
The target will not attack the caster.
@@ 6
The target receives a mark on his forehead or cheek, Each caster has his own
“mark” that this spell always gives.
@@ 7
As Unnerving Eye I, except the penalty is -20.
@@ 8
Target will flee in terror as fast as he can from the caster.
@@ 9
The target has a permanent fear of the caster. Target is at -10 to all actions
that might affect the caster in any way.
@@ 10
As Look of Disfigure I, except the penalty is -50.
@@ 11
The target must obey the caster’s suggestions as long as the suggestions are
not alien to him (e.g., suicide, blinding himself, etc.).
@@ 12
As Unnerving Eye I, except the penalty is -30.
@@ 13
As Look of Terror I, except the penalty is -20.
@@ 14
As Look of Disfigure I, except the penalty is -75.
@@ 15
Target is given one task; failure results in a penalty to be determined by the
GM.
@@ 16
As Unnerving Eye I, except the penalty is -50.
@@ 17
As Look of Terror I, except the penalty is -30.
@@ 18
Target is paralyzed with fear for the duration.
@@ 19
As Look of Disfigure I, except the penalty is -100.
@@ 20
As Unnerving Eye I, except the penalty is -75.
@@ 25
As Look of Terror I, except the penalty is -40.
@@ 30
Target’s appearance is so revolting that almost no one will deal with him.
Resolve as Look of Disfigure I, except the penalty is -150.
@@ 50
Target must resist or die.
